analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($25,795) vs SMA5/20/50 ($27,499/$29,543/$33,880): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating a weak position.
· Significant decline vs SMA100/200 ($36,893/$36,421): Mid/long-term trend weakening.
· 52-week position (22.7%) + Current price range is above the 52-week low ($16,760).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (47.2→35.7): Entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (211.9761→-338.2729): Bearish reversal and continued worsening.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $25,277): Approaching the lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($25,055): Close to current price, potential for further decline if broken downwards.
· Swing Resistance ($30,570): High level relative to current price, short-term rebound expected on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: Lower High formation, continuing bearish trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.55x): Volume contraction, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend): Need to monitor break of 25,055 support level, observation phase.
